'''2022 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Atlanta, Georgia, 13–16 October 2022. [[Justin Desai]] finished 1st in the Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-swccg-world-championship/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Dates:''' 13–16 October 2022
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81726 forum]
